reason: The question and rationale incorrectly cite Section 41 as designating IAPOA as the nominating organization. Per RA 9266, Section 4 designates IAPOA, while Section 41 is about implementing rules and regulations. The article explicitly warns about this exact error. The question text and rationale must be corrected.

proposed.text: Which organization does Section 4 designate as the source from which PRBoA nominees must be drawn?

options.text: IAPOA (Integrated and Accredited Professional Organization of Architects, now UAP)
Philippine Association of Construction Industries, which focuses on construction standards and practices
Association of Professional Engineers, which primarily represents engineering professionals
Philippine Institute of Civil Engineers, which focuses on civil engineering standards

rationale.a: Section 4 of RA 9266 designates IAPOA (now UAP) as the exclusive source from which PRBoA nominees are submitted to the Commission. Section 41 is about IRR adoption, not IAPOA nomination.
rationale.b: PACI represents construction, not the architecture profession.
rationale.c: APE represents engineers, not architects; engineers do not nominate the architecture board.
rationale.d: PICE represents civil engineers, not architects.
rationale.correct: Section 4 of RA 9266 designates the IAPOA—now the United Architects of the Philippines, Inc.—as the exclusive source from which PRBoA nominees are submitted to the Commission.
rationale.takeaway: Section 4 designates IAPOA/UAP as the nominating organization, NOT Section 41. This is a commonly tested distinction — Section 41 is about IRR adoption only.
